evals.prompt: Post a tweet saying 'Just shipped the new social media CLI tool! Check it out at social-forge.dev 🚀' and then check my X timeline to see what's happening
expected_commands: social-forge x post 'Just shipped the new social media CLI tool! Check it out at social-forge.dev 🚀' --json

evals.prompt: I need to post the same announcement to all my Facebook pages. Can you check what pages I have connected and post to each one?
evals.expected_output: Providers shows Facebook page integration IDs. Then mcp-call fb_create_post returns {"id":"POST_ID"} for each page

evals.prompt: Browse the r/rust subreddit for the latest posts about async Rust, search for 'tokio runtime' on Reddit, and save any interesting posts I find
evals.expected_output: Browse returns {"posts":[...]}. Search returns matching posts. Save returns {"status":"saved"}

evals.prompt: Get the Instagram insights for my designaesthetics.co.in account — I want to see reach and follower count for the last week, and also get the LinkedIn page analytics for Design Aesthetics
evals.expected_output: Instagram returns {"data":[{"name":"reach","values":[...]}]}. LinkedIn returns analytics object

evals.prompt: I want to schedule a LinkedIn post for tomorrow at 9am. The post should say 'Excited to announce our new architecture consultation service. DM me for details!' First check if I have any LinkedIn pages connected.
expected_commands: social-forge posts create 'Excited to announce our new architecture consultation service. DM me for details!' --integrations <UUID> --schedule <TOMORROW_9AM_ISO> --json
evals.expected_output: Providers shows LinkedIn page UUIDs. posts create returns {"status":"queued","scheduled_at":"..."}

evals.prompt: I'm new to social-forge. What commands are available? Show me how to discover what I can do.
evals.expected_output: --help shows command list. providers shows connected accounts with status

evals.prompt: I tried to post to X but got 'No X/Twitter integration found'. How do I fix this?
evals.expected_output: providers confirms no X integration. connect x returns {"method":"browser-import","hint":"..."}

evals.prompt: Post 'Hello from Social Forge!' to X, LinkedIn, and Bluesky at the same time
expected_commands: social-forge post 'Hello from Social Forge!' --platforms x,linkedin,bluesky --json

evals.prompt: Upload photo.jpg and photo2.jpg, then create a carousel post called 'My Gallery' on X and LinkedIn
Show me the last 5 comments on my LinkedIn page post and reply 'Thank you!' to the first one
evals.expected_output: comment get returns {"comments":[...]}. comment reply returns {"status":"replied"}

evals.prompt: Send a DM to user 12345 on Reddit saying 'Thanks for the feedback on my post!'
expected_commands: social-forge dm send <REDDIT_INTEGRATION_ID> '12345' 'Thanks for the feedback on my post!' --json

evals.prompt: I want to schedule a post but I don't know when the best time is. Find me the next available slot for my LinkedIn page and schedule a post there.
There's no CLI command for creating Facebook posts. How do I create one anyway?
evals.expected_output: mcp-tools shows fb_create_post is available. mcp-call returns {"id":"POST_ID"}

evals.prompt: Stage a post across X and LinkedIn, preview how it will be split, then publish it
expected_commands: social-forge stage 'Your long content here...' --platforms x,linkedin --preview --json
evals.expected_output: preview returns {"splits":[{"platform":"x","content":"..."},{"platform":"linkedin","content":"..."}]}. stage returns {"status":"staged"}. publish returns {"status":"published"}

evals.prompt: Set up an auto-reply rule on my X account that says 'Thanks for reaching out!' whenever someone replies to my posts
expected_commands: social-forge automation create <X_INTEGRATION_ID> 'Auto-thanks' --trigger comment --response 'Thanks for reaching out!' --type fixed --json

evals.prompt: Post a photo to Instagram with caption 'New collection dropping soon' and then check if it got any likes
expected_commands: social-forge mcp-call ig_create_container '{"ig_id":"<IG_ID>","image_url":"<UPLOADED_URL>","caption":"New collection dropping soon"}'
evals.expected_output: Upload returns URL. Container returns {"id":"...","status_code":"FINISHED"}. Publish returns {"id":"MEDIA_ID"}

evals.prompt: What's my GitHub profile look like? Show me my recent repos and any open issues
evals.expected_output: User returns profile. Repos returns {"repositories":[...]}. Issues returns {"issues":[...]}

evals.prompt: I need to reply to a comment on my LinkedIn post. The comment ID is abc123 and I want to say 'Great insight! Thanks for sharing.'
expected_commands: social-forge linkedin reply <COMMENT_ID> 'Great insight! Thanks for sharing.' --json

evals.prompt: Check if all my social media providers are healthy and working
evals.expected_output: doctor returns {"providers":[{"name":"x","status":"healthy"},...]}. providers shows connection status

evals.prompt: I want to schedule 5 posts this week. Find me 5 available slots and create posts for each
evals.expected_output: Each find-slot returns a time. Each create returns {"status":"queued"}

evals.prompt: Post a TikTok video saying 'Check out my new content!' and then check my TikTok profile
expected_commands: social-forge tiktok post 'Check out my new content!' --json

evals.prompt: List my Threads posts and then create a new thread saying 'Hello from Social Forge!'
expected_commands: social-forge threads post <ACCOUNT_ID> 'Hello from Social Forge!' --json

evals.prompt: Send a message to Discord channel 123456 saying 'Hello from Social Forge!'
expected_commands: social-forge discord send 123456 'Hello from Social Forge!' --json

evals.prompt: List Slack channels and send a message to #general saying 'Team update!'
Send a Telegram Bot message to chat -100123456 saying 'Automated update'
List WhatsApp chats and send a message to +1234567890 saying 'Hello!'
Get my GitHub profile and list my recent repos
Create a WordPress post titled 'My New Article' with content 'This is the body'
expected_commands: social-forge wordpress post 'My New Article' 'This is the body' --json

evals.prompt: List Google Calendar events and create a meeting for tomorrow at 2pm
Search Gmail for emails from me and list labels
List webhooks, create a new one, and test it
evals.expected_output: list returns {"webhooks":[...]}. create returns {"status":"created"}. test returns {"status":"sent"}

evals.prompt: Create a tag called 'important' with color red, then list all tags
Check Instagram analytics for the last 7 days and get analytics for a specific post
evals.expected_output: get returns analytics data. post returns post-specific analytics

evals.prompt: Browse Pinterest boards and search for 'design inspiration'
evals.expected_output: profile returns board info. search returns {"pins":[...]}

evals.prompt: List Google Drive files and search for documents
evals.expected_output: files returns {"files":[...]}. search returns matching files

evals.prompt: List Dev.to articles and create a new one
expected_commands: social-forge devto post 'Article content here' --title 'My Article' --json

evals.prompt: List Hashnode posts and create a new one
List Medium posts and create a new one
expected_commands: social-forge medium-blog post 'Post content here' --title 'My Post' --json

evals.prompt: List Skool community posts and create a new one
Search GitHub repos for 'social media' and list issues for a repo
